_meta.purpose: Claims-layer rule-coverage gold for the WCP leave feature (57B-374). The measured object is the REPORT / CLAIMS layer (extractKnowledge over a run's claims/*.json, diffed by diffKnowledge), one layer BELOW the FG boundary gold (boundary-gold.json, 57B-370) and the fact-pack gold (57B-372). It pins the depth-foundation red: material leave rules whose source is in-scope and in the fact pack, yet which the author never wrote into claims. The metric is diffKnowledge as-is; this file is DATA.
_meta.constructionMethod: Three tiers. Every anchor is a full module-prefixed path exactly as it appears in a run's resolved evidence windows (e.g. wcp-service-v2/internal/handlers/support/service.go), with a line window pinned to the DECIDING source region and verified line-by-line against the read-only target excavator-test-repos/wcp. statementPatterns are single-semantic and harvested verbatim from three real runs' claim statements (C1 00:50 green, C1v2 13:47 red, demo 16:37) — only-widen-never-narrow per 57B-365. markers are limited to [fact,verified] (authored assertions, not inferred/unavailable). Attribution (authoring-miss vs prepare-miss) is a function of each run's own prepareHorizon: T1/T2 anchor files are in the fact pack / scope of the pinned runs -> authoring-miss when they still miss; T3 frontend files (except EditLeaveHoursModal.tsx) are NOT in the prepared horizon -> prepare-miss.

tiers.T1: 3 confirmed claims-layer misses, mustFind, RED today (miss in BOTH the C1v2 red and C1 green runs at the claims layer, except the auto-complete cron which the green run does cover). Their source is present and their anchor file reached the fact pack / scope, so the miss is an AUTHORING miss, not a prepare gap. The depth-improvement slices must turn these green.
tiers.T2: 9 regression sentinels, mustFind, GREEN today. Each is solidly covered in the C1 00:50 green run and re-verified against source; guards against a future depth change pushing today's correctly-authored leave core back out.
tiers.T3: 3 optional frontend sensors (never mustFind, never gate). Anchored to leave UI files that are NOT in the prepared horizon of the pinned runs, so they MISS with attribution prepare-miss today — the intended reading that pre-instruments the frontend-horizon slice. NOT individually adjudicated for substantiveness.

recalibration_57B_376.why: The 57B-374 gold was calibrated on the PRE-forcing runs (C1v2 red, C1 00:50 green). The 57B-375 forcing function changed HOW the author organizes/phrases rule coverage, so a fresh POST-forcing run (effect, 17:31) covers rules the old narrow single-semantic patterns / anchors no longer matched. Re-diffing the effect run against the pre-forcing gold false-read 3/15 found (9 mustFind reported missing, most of them actually covered under new wording). This block records the ONLY-WIDEN-NEVER-NARROW recalibration: every widening is a strict superset of the prior form (appended alternation / added anchor) justified by an actual covering claim read in the effect run; the RED/GREEN readings are preserved.
recalibration_57B_376.beforeAfterEffect: found 3/15 -> 10/15.
